raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Mooncake's strict MNNVL EGM Store requires `MC_PHYSICAL_GPU` to contain the
host-local physical GPU ordinal used for requester placement. SGLang
tensor-parallel workers inherit the same parent container environment while
selecting different CUDA logical devices, so a single container-wide scalar
cannot correctly represent every worker.

Without process-local resolution, TP>1 workers may all advertise the same
physical GPU and select the wrong EGM placement.

### Dependency

This PR depends on **kvcache-ai/Mooncake#5161**:

- https://github.com/kvcache-ai/Mooncake/pull/5161
- Commits: https://github.com/kvcache-ai/Mooncake/pull/5161/commits
- `9a331f020a7da1142d5a6164b8437c7eb4cb7999`: strict MNNVL EGM Store support
- `f194d147b0f07854180c651ff057bab5fb0e61ff`: parser and EGM unregister fixes

Mooncake#5161 is a separate PR submitted to the Mooncake repository. This
SGLang PR does not duplicate its implementation; it adapts SGLang Direct Linker
workers to the interfaces and placement requirements introduced there.
Specifically, Mooncake#5161 introduces the Store protocols `mnnvl` and
`nvlink_host`, physical requester placement, and the `MC_PHYSICAL_GPU`
requirement used here. Classic `nvlink`, TCP, and RDMA paths are outside this
change.

## Modifications

- Detect the Mooncake Store MNNVL protocols `mnnvl` and `nvlink_host`.
- Resolve each worker's current CUDA logical device through numeric
  `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` before the lazy Mooncake Store import/initialization.
- Set the process-local `MC_PHYSICAL_GPU` and log the TP rank, CUDA device, and
  resolved physical GPU.
- Support non-contiguous and reordered visibility such as
  `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1,3`.
- Reject a conflicting container-wide `MC_PHYSICAL_GPU` when a numeric
  visibility map proves that it is wrong for the current worker.
- Require an explicit physical ordinal for UUID/MIG visibility instead of
  silently treating CUDA logical device 0 as physical GPU 0.
- Leave non-MNNVL protocols unchanged without querying CUDA or modifying
  `MC_PHYSICAL_GPU`.

The implementation is independent of a particular TP size. Its execution
model requirement is one selected CUDA device per SGLang worker process.

## Accuracy Tests

This change does not modify model forward code, KV keys, page layout, cache
lookup, or load/offload semantics.

Added hardware-independent unit coverage for:

- TP2 mapping with `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1,3`;
- reordered mappings across eight logical workers;
- explicit physical GPU validation and conflict detection;
- UUID/MIG visibility behavior;
- `mnnvl` / `nvlink_host` protocol selection;
- classic `nvlink` and RDMA non-regression behavior;
- per-worker environment configuration.

Local checks:

```text
Ruff check: passed
Ruff format --check: passed
py_compile: passed
isolated hardware-independent mapping test harness: 15 passed
```

Prior integration validation used 4x NVIDIA GB300 and TP4 with the same mapping
logic:

```text
TP0/1/2/3 -> physical GPU 0/1/2/3
MNNVL strict EGM offload and load-back: 5632 cached tokens restored
RDMA regression on the patched SGLang source: 6144 cached tokens restored
```

The original hardware environment is no longer available, so this patch on the
current SGLang `main` commit has not been re-run on that cluster. The TP2 and
arbitrary-size coverage above is hardware-independent; the TP4 GB300 result is
reported as prior integration evidence rather than a current CI result.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable. The new resolution runs once during Direct Linker
initialization and does not change the request data path.

## Checklist

- [x] Format the changed files with Ruff and run `ruff format --check`.
- [x] Add hardware-independent unit tests for protocol and GPU mapping behavior.
- [ ] Run the repository unit test through SGLang CI (local environment does not
      contain the full SGLang Python/CUDA dependency set).
- [ ] Re-run current-main integration on MNNVL hardware when an environment is
      available.
- [x] Document the dependency on Mooncake#5161 and the hardware-validation
      boundary in this PR description.
- [x] No accuracy or request-path performance change.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,705 @@
+# Mooncake MNNVL/EGM and SGLang Direct Linker Deployment and Validation Guide
+
+## 1. Overview
+
+This guide describes the validated integration of Mooncake MNNVL/EGM with the
+SGLang unified-cache external linker. It covers the complete path from NVIDIA
+IMEX and NVLink Fabric Memory to Mooncake Store and SGLang GPU KV-cache reuse.
+
+The integration provides two capabilities:
+
+1. A distributed Mooncake EGM memory pool with directed cross-node object
+   placement and MNNVL data transfer.
+2. A native SGLang Direct Linker path that offloads GPU KV cache to Mooncake and
+   restores it directly into the SGLang GPU KV pool.
+
+```text
+SGLang GPU KV Cache
+        ↓ Direct Linker offload
+Mooncake Store
+        ↓ MNNVL / NVLink Fabric
+Local or remote EGM Segment
+        ↓ Direct Linker lookup + load-back
+SGLang GPU KV Cache
+```
+
+The validated hardware consisted of two servers with four NVIDIA GB300 GPUs per
+server. The SGLang functional validation used DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with tensor
+parallel size four.
+
+## 2. Community dependencies
+
+Mooncake support is provided by:
+
+- [kvcache-ai/Mooncake#5161](https://github.com/kvcache-ai/Mooncake/pull/5161)
+- [Mooncake #5161 commits](https://github.com/kvcache-ai/Mooncake/pull/5161/commits)
+
+Mooncake PR #5161 provides:
+
+- the strict MNNVL EGM Store;
+- the `mnnvl` and `nvlink_host` Store protocols;
+- physical requester placement;
+- the `MC_PHYSICAL_GPU` interface;
+- one EGM owner process per physical GPU;
+- request-scoped CUDA producer-event ordering.
+
+The SGLang integration is tracked by:
+
+- [sgl-project/sglang#48088](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/48088)
+
+The SGLang change resolves and injects a physical GPU identity in every Direct
+Linker worker before Mooncake Store initialization.
+
+## 3. Architecture
+
+### 3.1 Control plane
+
+The control plane contains:
+
+```text
+Mooncake Master RPC
+Mooncake Metadata service
+Mooncake metrics endpoint
+SGLang HTTP API
+```
+
+The Master maintains keys, replicas, allocations, and segment membership. The
+Metadata service publishes Transfer Engine segment descriptors and fabric
+handles.
+
+### 3.2 Data plane
+
+The KV-cache data plane is:
+
+```text
+SGLang Worker GPU buffer
+        ↕
+Mooncake MNNVL Transport
+        ↕
+EGM host-memory segment exported through NVLink Fabric
+```
+
+Master RPC and Metadata HTTP traffic remain control-plane traffic. KV-cache
+payload movement uses the selected Mooncake data protocol.
+
+### 3.3 EGM owner topology
+
+Each physical GPU has one owner process. The owner:
+
+1. selects one physical GPU;
+2. allocates host memory on the GPU-nearest NUMA node;
+3. exports the allocation through NVIDIA Fabric Memory;
+4. publishes the segment metadata;
+5. mounts the segment into Mooncake Master;
+6. keeps the exported segment alive for clients.
+
+An owner is ready when its log contains:
+
+```text
+MNNVL_SEGMENT_READY
+exported=1
+metadata_published=1
+master_mounted=1
+OWNER_READY
+```
+
+### 3.4 SGLang Direct Linker topology
+
+The Direct Linker connects `UnifiedRadixCache` directly to Mooncake:
+
+```text
+GPU KV cache
+    ↕
+MooncakeDirectLinker
+    ↕
+MooncakeDistributedStore
+```
+
+The path has no SGLang host-cache tier. Direct Linker performs page existence
+queries, asynchronous offload, layer-wise loading, and GPU-buffer registration.
+
+## 4. Physical GPU identity
+
+### 4.1 Placement identity
+
+Mooncake MNNVL placement uses:
+
+```text
+MC_PHYSICAL_GPU
+MOONCAKE_FABRIC_DOMAIN
+MC_RACK
+MC_TRAY
+MOONCAKE_HOST_ID
+```
+
+`MC_PHYSICAL_GPU` is the host-local physical GPU ordinal. It is distinct from a
+CUDA logical index after visibility remapping.
+
+### 4.2 Worker-local resolution
+
+SGLang worker processes inherit a common container environment and select their
+own CUDA logical devices. Each worker performs the following sequence:
+
+```text
+torch.cuda.current_device()
+        ↓
+CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES mapping
+        ↓
+host-local physical GPU ordinal
+        ↓
+process-local MC_PHYSICAL_GPU
+        ↓
+Mooncake Store initialization
+```
+
+The mapping uses the active CUDA device rather than the TP rank. It applies to
+TP2, TP4, TP8, and other one-process-per-GPU deployments.
+
+### 4.3 TP2 example
+
+```text
+CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1,3
+
+Worker cuda:0 → physical GPU 1
+Worker cuda:1 → physical GPU 3
+```
+
+### 4.4 TP8 reordered-device example
+
+```text
+CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7,2,5,1,6,0,4,3
+
+cuda:0 → physical GPU 7
+cuda:1 → physical GPU 2
+cuda:2 → physical GPU 5
+cuda:3 → physical GPU 1
+cuda:4 → physical GPU 6
+cuda:5 → physical GPU 0
+cuda:6 → physical GPU 4
+cuda:7 → physical GPU 3
+```
+
+### 4.5 UUID and MIG visibility
+
+For GPU UUID or MIG visibility, configure the host-local physical ordinal in
+the worker environment:
+
+```bash
+export MC_PHYSICAL_GPU=<PHYSICAL_GPU_ORDINAL>
+```
+
+For numeric visibility, an explicit `MC_PHYSICAL_GPU` value must match the
+worker's `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` mapping.
+
+## 5. Mooncake MNNVL/EGM deployment
+
+### 5.1 Verify NVIDIA IMEX
+
+Run on every participating server:
+
+```bash
+nvidia-smi -L
+nvidia-imex-ctl -N
+systemctl status nvidia-imex
+```
+
+Required state:
+
+```text
+READY
+CONNECTED
+Fabric State: Completed
+Fabric Status: Success
+Fabric Health: Healthy
+Fabric Bandwidth: Full
+```
+
+### 5.2 Build Mooncake
+
+Build Mooncake PR #5161 with CUDA and TENT enabled. The build must produce:
+
+```text
+mooncake_master
+Mooncake Python package
+Mooncake native libraries
+scripts/launch_egm_owners.py
+```
+
+### 5.3 Start Mooncake Master
+
+```bash
+./build-mnnvl/mooncake-store/src/mooncake_master \
+  --rpc_address=0.0.0.0 \
+  --rpc_port=<MASTER_PORT>
+```
+
+Verify:
+
+```bash
+ss -lntp | grep <MASTER_PORT>
+timeout 2 bash -c '</dev/tcp/<MASTER_HOST>/<MASTER_PORT>' && echo MASTER_OK
+```
+
+### 5.4 Start EGM owners on node A
+
+```bash
+python3 scripts/launch_egm_owners.py \
+  --host <NODE_A_HOST> \
+  --rack <RACK> \
+  --fabric-domain <FABRIC_DOMAIN> \
+  --master <MASTER_HOST>:<MASTER_PORT> \
+  --gpus 0,1,2,3 \
+  --base-port <NODE_A_BASE_PORT> \
+  --segment-gib 4 \
+  --log-dir /tmp/mooncake-egm-owners-a
+```
+
+### 5.5 Start EGM owners on node B
+
+```bash
+python3 scripts/launch_egm_owners.py \
+  --host <NODE_B_HOST> \
+  --rack <RACK> \
+  --fabric-domain <FABRIC_DOMAIN> \
+  --master <MASTER_HOST>:<MASTER_PORT> \
+  --gpus 0,1,2,3 \
+  --base-port <NODE_B_BASE_PORT> \
+  --segment-gib 4 \
+  --log-dir /tmp/mooncake-egm-owners-b
+```
+
+### 5.6 Verify owners
+
+```bash
+grep -R 'MNNVL_SEGMENT_READY\|OWNER_READY' \
+  /tmp/mooncake-egm-owners-a
+
+grep -R 'MNNVL_SEGMENT_READY\|OWNER_READY' \
+  /tmp/mooncake-egm-owners-b
+```
+
+Record every complete segment name and Transfer Engine endpoint.
+
+## 6. Directed cross-node Store validation
+
+### 6.1 Configure the client
+
+```bash
+export MOONCAKE_STORE_BACKEND=cpp
+export CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID
+export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
+export MC_PHYSICAL_GPU=0
+export MC_RACK=<RACK>
+export MC_TRAY=<CLIENT_HOST>
+export MOONCAKE_HOST_ID=<CLIENT_HOST>
+export MOONCAKE_FABRIC_DOMAIN=<FABRIC_DOMAIN>
+export MC_USE_TENT=1
+export MC_ENABLE_MNNVL=1
+export MC_MNNVL_EGM=1
+```
+
+### 6.2 Create a directed request
+
+```python
+from mooncake.store import MooncakeDistributedStore, ReplicateConfig
+
+store = MooncakeDistributedStore()
+ret = store.setup(
+    "<CLIENT_HOST>:<CLIENT_PORT>",
+    "<METADATA_SERVER>",
+    0,
+    64 * 1024 * 1024,
+    "mnnvl",
+    "",
+    "<MASTER_HOST>:<MASTER_PORT>",
+)
+assert ret == 0
+
+config = ReplicateConfig()
+config.replica_num = 1
+config.preferred_segments = ["<REMOTE_SEGMENT_NAME>"]
+config.fabric_domain = "<FABRIC_DOMAIN>"
+
+payload = b"x" * (16 * 1024 * 1024)
+assert store.put("mnnvl-directed-object", payload, config) == 0
+assert store.get("mnnvl-directed-object") == payload
+```
+
+### 6.3 Verify remote placement
+
+Check `get_replica_desc()` and confirm:
+
+```text
+Replica Status: COMPLETE
+Replica Type: MEMORY
+Replica Segment: selected remote segment
+Replica Endpoint: remote node endpoint
+GET length: payload length
+SHA256 Match: YES
+```
+
+Run the same test in both directions.
+
+## 7. SGLang Direct Linker deployment
+
+### 7.1 Install the Mooncake runtime
+
+Keep the SGLang image's PyTorch and NCCL packages on the default Python path.
+Expose the Mooncake package and native libraries separately:
+
+```bash
+export PYTHONPATH=<MOONCAKE_PYTHON_PACKAGE_PARENT>:$PYTHONPATH
+export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=<MOONCAKE_NATIVE_LIBRARY_DIR>:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
+```
+
+### 7.2 Configure Mooncake
+
+```bash
+export MOONCAKE_STORE_BACKEND=cpp
+export MOONCAKE_PROTOCOL=mnnvl
+export MC_USE_TENT=1
+export MC_ENABLE_MNNVL=1
+export MC_MNNVL_EGM=1
+export MOONCAKE_FABRIC_DOMAIN=<FABRIC_DOMAIN>
+export MC_RACK=<RACK>
+export MC_TRAY=<HOST_ID>
+export MOONCAKE_HOST_ID=<HOST_ID>
+export MOONCAKE_MASTER=<MASTER_HOST>:<MASTER_PORT>
+export MOONCAKE_TE_META_DATA_SERVER=http://<METADATA_HOST>:<METADATA_PORT>/metadata
+```
+
+### 7.3 Launch SGLang
+
+```bash
+python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
+  --model-path <MODEL_PATH> \
+  --served-model-name <MODEL_NAME> \
+  --host 0.0.0.0 \
+  --port 30000 \
+  --tp <TP_SIZE> \
+  --page-size 256 \
+  --chunked-prefill-size 4096 \
+  --max-total-tokens 8192 \
+  --max-running-requests 1 \
+  --enable-cache-report \
+  --enable-metrics \
+  --enable-unified-cache-external-linker \
+  --unified-cache-external-linker-backend mooncake \
+  --unified-cache-external-linker-config \
+    '{"enable_group_semantics":true,"protocol":"mnnvl"}'
+```
+
+### 7.4 Verify startup
+
+```bash
+curl -i http://127.0.0.1:30000/health
+```
+
+Expected log entries:
+
+```text
+Mooncake direct linker MNNVL rank identity
+Mooncake store setup successfully
+Mooncake store warmup successfully
+Mooncake direct linker storage topology
+MnnvlTransport: EGM host memory over NVLink enabled (strict)
+```
+
+## 8. KV-cache offload and load-back validation
+
+Size the GPU KV pool to retain only one of two unrelated long prefixes at a
+time.
+
+1. Send long prefix A and confirm a cold request.
+2. Send unrelated long prefix B and fill the local GPU KV pool.
+3. Send prefix A again and confirm external cache recovery.
+
+Validation evidence:
+
+```text
+Mooncake direct linker offload: tokens=<TOKENS>
+Mooncake direct linker lookup hit: pages=<PAGES>
+cached_tokens_details.host = <PAGES> × <PAGE_SIZE>
+Mooncake Master Batch Get: success
+Mooncake Master ExistKey: success
+```
+
+The validated DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash TP4 run produced:
+
+```text
+TP0 → physical_gpu=0
+TP1 → physical_gpu=1
+TP2 → physical_gpu=2
+TP3 → physical_gpu=3
+
+Prompt tokens: 6001
+External cached tokens: 5632
+Lookup pages: 22
+Page size: 256 tokens
+22 × 256 = 5632 tokens restored
+```
+
+The MNNVL EGM path completed:
+
+```text
+GPU → MNNVL/NVLink → EGM offload: PASS
+EGM → MNNVL/NVLink → GPU load-back: PASS
+```
+
+## 9. RDMA transport validation
+

+## Mooncake Direct Linker with MNNVL EGM
+
+The unified-cache external linker connects SGLang's GPU KV cache directly to
+Mooncake without a host-cache tier:
+
+For the complete architecture, deployment, validation, stress-test, monitoring,
+and community contribution workflow, see
+[Mooncake MNNVL/EGM and SGLang Direct Linker Deployment and Validation Guide](./MNNVL_EGM_DIRECT_LINKER_DEPLOYMENT_AND_VALIDATION.md).
+
+```text
+SGLang GPU KV cache
+        ↓ offload
+Mooncake MNNVL EGM Store
+        ↓ lookup and load-back
+SGLang GPU KV cache
+```
+
+This integration uses the strict MNNVL EGM Store introduced by
+[kvcache-ai/Mooncake#5161](https://github.com/kvcache-ai/Mooncake/pull/5161).
+That Mooncake change provides the `mnnvl` and `nvlink_host` Store protocols,
+physical requester placement, and the `MC_PHYSICAL_GPU` interface.
+
+### Physical GPU identity
+
+Mooncake placement uses the host-local physical GPU ordinal. SGLang workers
+inherit the parent container environment and select their own CUDA logical
+devices, so the Direct Linker resolves and sets `MC_PHYSICAL_GPU` in every
+worker before Mooncake Store initialization.
+
+Numeric `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` mappings are resolved directly. For example:
+
+```text
+CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1,3
+
+cuda:0 → physical GPU 1
+cuda:1 → physical GPU 3
+```
+
+The same rule applies to any tensor-parallel size when every worker process
+selects one CUDA device. Non-contiguous and reordered visibility lists are
+supported:
+
+```text
+CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7,2,5,1,6,0,4,3
+
+cuda:0 → physical GPU 7
+cuda:1 → physical GPU 2
+cuda:2 → physical GPU 5
+cuda:3 → physical GPU 1
+cuda:4 → physical GPU 6
+cuda:5 → physical GPU 0
+cuda:6 → physical GPU 4
+cuda:7 → physical GPU 3
+```
+
+For GPU UUID or MIG visibility, set the physical ordinal explicitly in each
+worker environment:
+
+```bash
+export MC_PHYSICAL_GPU=<PHYSICAL_GPU_ORDINAL>
+```
+
+An explicit numeric `MC_PHYSICAL_GPU` must match the current worker's numeric
+`CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` mapping.
+
+### Prerequisites
+
+1. Configure NVIDIA IMEX and verify that participating nodes are connected.
+2. Build Mooncake with TENT, CUDA, and the strict MNNVL EGM Store support from
+   [Mooncake PR #5161](https://github.com/kvcache-ai/Mooncake/pull/5161).
+3. Start a Mooncake Master and metadata service.
+4. Start one EGM owner process per physical GPU and mount every exported segment
+   into the same Mooncake memory pool.
+5. Use the same fabric domain, rack, and host identity across owners and SGLang
+   workers.
+
+Each owner must report:
+
+```text
+MNNVL_SEGMENT_READY
+exported=1
+metadata_published=1
+master_mounted=1
+OWNER_READY
+```
+
+### Environment
+
+Configure the SGLang container with the Mooncake package and native libraries
+built from Mooncake PR #5161:
+
+```bash
+export PYTHONPATH=<MOONCAKE_PYTHON_PACKAGE_PARENT>:$PYTHONPATH
+export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=<MOONCAKE_NATIVE_LIBRARY_DIR>:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
+
+export MOONCAKE_STORE_BACKEND=cpp
+export MOONCAKE_PROTOCOL=mnnvl
+export MOONCAKE_MASTER=<MASTER_HOST>:<MASTER_PORT>
+export MOONCAKE_TE_META_DATA_SERVER=http://<METADATA_HOST>:<METADATA_PORT>/metadata
+export MOONCAKE_FABRIC_DOMAIN=<FABRIC_DOMAIN>
+export MC_RACK=<RACK>
+export MC_TRAY=<HOST_ID>
+export MOONCAKE_HOST_ID=<HOST_ID>
+export MC_USE_TENT=1
+export MC_ENABLE_MNNVL=1
+export MC_MNNVL_EGM=1
+```
+
+Keep the SGLang image's PyTorch and NCCL packages on the default Python path.
+Add only the Mooncake Python package and its native library directory.
+
+### Launch SGLang
+
+```bash
+python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
+  --model-path <MODEL_PATH> \
+  --served-model-name <MODEL_NAME> \
+  --host 0.0.0.0 \
+  --port 30000 \
+  --tp <TP_SIZE> \
+  --page-size 256 \
+  --enable-cache-report \
+  --enable-metrics \
+  --enable-unified-cache-external-linker \
+  --unified-cache-external-linker-backend mooncake \
+  --unified-cache-external-linker-config \
+    '{"enable_group_semantics":true,"protocol":"mnnvl"}'
+```
+
+Every worker logs its resolved identity before Mooncake Store initialization:
+
+```text
+Mooncake direct linker MNNVL rank identity:
+tp_rank=<RANK>/<TP_SIZE>, cuda_device=<LOGICAL_GPU>, physical_gpu=<PHYSICAL_GPU>
+```
+
+Successful initialization includes:
+
+```text
+Mooncake store setup successfully
+Mooncake store warmup successfully
+Mooncake direct linker storage topology
+MnnvlTransport: EGM host memory over NVLink enabled (strict)
+```
+
+### Validate offload and load-back
+
+Use a GPU KV pool that cannot retain two long, unrelated prefixes at once, then
+run this request sequence:
+
+1. Send long prefix A and confirm a cold request.
+2. Send unrelated long prefix B to evict A from the local GPU KV pool.
+3. Send prefix A again and confirm external cache recovery.
+
+The logs and API response provide the validation evidence:
+
+```text
+Mooncake direct linker offload: tokens=<TOKENS>
+Mooncake direct linker lookup hit: pages=<PAGES>
+cached_tokens_details.host = <PAGES> × <PAGE_SIZE>
+Mooncake Master Batch Get: success
+Mooncake Master ExistKey: success
+```
+
+### Select the transport protocol
+
+MNNVL EGM:
+
+```json
+{
+  "enable_group_semantics": true,
+  "protocol": "mnnvl"
+}
+```
+
+RDMA:
+
+```json
+{
+  "enable_group_semantics": true,
+  "protocol": "rdma",
+  "device_name": "mlx5_0,mlx5_1"
+}
+```
+
+The physical GPU identity setup runs only for the Store MNNVL protocols
+`mnnvl` and `nvlink_host`. TCP, RDMA, and classic `nvlink` keep their existing
+initialization paths.

+def _uses_mnnvl(extra_config: dict) -> bool:
+    protocol = (
+        str(extra_config.get("protocol") or os.environ.get("MOONCAKE_PROTOCOL", ""))
+        .strip()
+        .lower()
+    )
+    return protocol in {"mnnvl", "nvlink_host"}
+
+
+def _resolve_mnnvl_physical_gpu(
+    logical_gpu: int,
+    visible_devices: str | None,
+    configured_physical_gpu: str | None,
+) -> int:
+    """Resolve a CUDA logical device to Mooncake's physical GPU ordinal.
+
+    Mooncake MNNVL placement requires a host-local physical GPU ordinal. SGLang
+    workers can share the same parent container environment while selecting
+    different CUDA devices, so the value must be resolved in each worker.
+
+    Numeric CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES mappings are resolved directly. UUID and MIG
+    mappings require an explicit MC_PHYSICAL_GPU because their physical ordinal
+    cannot be inferred safely without an external device inventory.
+    """
+
+    if logical_gpu < 0:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"CUDA logical device must be non-negative; got {logical_gpu}."
+        )
+
+    visible_devices = (visible_devices or "").strip()
+    derived_physical_gpu = None
+    if visible_devices:
+        entries = [entry.strip() for entry in visible_devices.split(",")]
+        if logical_gpu >= len(entries):
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"CUDA logical device {logical_gpu} is outside "
+                f"CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES={visible_devices!r}."
+            )
+        mapped_device = entries[logical_gpu]
+        derived_physical_gpu = int(mapped_device) if mapped_device.isdigit() else None
+
+    configured = (configured_physical_gpu or "").strip()
+    if configured:
+        try:
+            physical_gpu = int(configured)
+        except ValueError as error:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"MC_PHYSICAL_GPU must be a non-negative integer; got {configured!r}."
+            ) from error
+        if physical_gpu < 0:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"MC_PHYSICAL_GPU must be a non-negative integer; got {configured!r}."
+            )
+        if derived_physical_gpu is not None and physical_gpu != derived_physical_gpu:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"MC_PHYSICAL_GPU={physical_gpu} conflicts with CUDA logical "
+                f"device {logical_gpu}, which maps to physical GPU "
+                f"{derived_physical_gpu} through "
+                f"CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES={visible_devices!r}."
+            )
+        return physical_gpu
+
+    if not visible_devices:
+        return logical_gpu
+    if derived_physical_gpu is not None:
+        return derived_physical_gpu
+    raise RuntimeError(
+        "Mooncake MNNVL requires the physical GPU ordinal, but "
+        f"CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES maps logical device {logical_gpu} to "
+        f"{entries[logical_gpu]!r}. Set MC_PHYSICAL_GPU explicitly for "
+        "UUID/MIG device mappings."
+    )
+
+
+def _configure_mnnvl_physical_gpu(extra_config: dict) -> int | None:
+    if not _uses_mnnvl(extra_config):
+        return None
+    logical_gpu = torch.cuda.current_device()
+    physical_gpu = _resolve_mnnvl_physical_gpu(
+        logical_gpu,
+        os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"),
+        os.environ.get("MC_PHYSICAL_GPU"),
+    )
+    os.environ["MC_PHYSICAL_GPU"] = str(physical_gpu)
+    return physical_gpu
+

+
+import os
+import unittest
+from unittest import mock
+
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.storage.mooncake_store.mooncake_direct_linker import (
+    _configure_mnnvl_physical_gpu,
+    _resolve_mnnvl_physical_gpu,

+)

+

+
+
+class TestMooncakeMnnvlProtocolDetection(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_detects_store_mnnvl_protocols(self):
+        self.assertTrue(_uses_mnnvl({"protocol": "mnnvl"}))
+        self.assertTrue(_uses_mnnvl({"protocol": "NVLINK_HOST"}))
+
+    def test_classic_nvlink_protocol_is_not_store_mnnvl(self):
+        self.assertFalse(_uses_mnnvl({"protocol": "nvlink"}))
+
+    def test_explicit_protocol_overrides_environment(self):
+        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"MOONCAKE_PROTOCOL": "mnnvl"}):
+            self.assertFalse(_uses_mnnvl({"protocol": "rdma"}))
+
+    def test_uses_protocol_environment_when_config_is_omitted(self):
+        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"MOONCAKE_PROTOCOL": "mnnvl"}):
+            self.assertTrue(_uses_mnnvl({}))
+
+
+class TestMooncakeMnnvlPhysicalGpuResolution(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_resolves_tp2_numeric_visible_devices(self):
+        self.assertEqual(_resolve_mnnvl_physical_gpu(0, "1,3", None), 1)
+        self.assertEqual(_resolve_mnnvl_physical_gpu(1, "1,3", None), 3)
+
+    def test_resolves_arbitrary_tp_size_and_device_order(self):
+        visible_devices = "7,2,5,1,6,0,4,3"
+        resolved = [
+            _resolve_mnnvl_physical_gpu(rank, visible_devices, None)
+            for rank in range(8)
+        ]
+        self.assertEqual(resolved, [7, 2, 5, 1, 6, 0, 4, 3])
+
+    def test_uses_logical_device_when_visibility_is_unrestricted(self):
+        self.assertEqual(_resolve_mnnvl_physical_gpu(3, None, None), 3)
+
+    def test_accepts_matching_explicit_physical_gpu(self):
+        self.assertEqual(_resolve_mnnvl_physical_gpu(1, "1,3", "3"), 3)
+
+    def test_explicit_physical_gpu_is_authoritative_without_visibility_map(self):
+        self.assertEqual(_resolve_mnnvl_physical_gpu(0, None, "3"), 3)
+
+    def test_rejects_container_wide_gpu_value_that_conflicts_with_worker(self):
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "conflicts with CUDA logical"):
+            _resolve_mnnvl_physical_gpu(1, "0,1", "0")
+
+    def test_rejects_invalid_explicit_physical_gpu(self):
+        for value in ("gpu0", "-1"):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(value=value),
+                self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "must be a non-negative integer"),
+            ):
+                _resolve_mnnvl_physical_gpu(0, "0,1", value)
+
+    def test_rejects_logical_device_outside_visibility(self):
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "outside CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"):
+            _resolve_mnnvl_physical_gpu(2, "1,3", None)
+
+    def test_uuid_and_mig_visibility_require_explicit_physical_gpu(self):
+        for visible_device in ("GPU-1234", "MIG-1234"):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(visible_device=visible_device),
+                self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "Set MC_PHYSICAL_GPU explicitly"),
+            ):
+                _resolve_mnnvl_physical_gpu(0, visible_device, None)
+            self.assertEqual(_resolve_mnnvl_physical_gpu(0, visible_device, "2"), 2)
+
+
+class TestMooncakeMnnvlPhysicalGpuConfiguration(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.environment = mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=False)
+        self.environment.start()
+        self.addCleanup(self.environment.stop)
+        for name in (
+            "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES",
+            "MC_PHYSICAL_GPU",
+            "MOONCAKE_PROTOCOL",
+        ):
+            os.environ.pop(name, None)
+
+    def test_configures_each_tp2_worker_independently(self):
+        os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = "1,3"
+        for logical_gpu, expected_physical_gpu in ((0, 1), (1, 3)):
+            os.environ.pop("MC_PHYSICAL_GPU", None)

+                physical_gpu = _configure_mnnvl_physical_gpu({"protocol": "mnnvl"})
+            self.assertEqual(physical_gpu, expected_physical_gpu)
+            self.assertEqual(os.environ["MC_PHYSICAL_GPU"], str(expected_physical_gpu))

+    def test_does_not_touch_non_mnnvl_protocols(self):
+        os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = "0,1"

+        ):
